name: Abe Avila
bio:
Abe Avila is a highly skilled tattoo artist based in Camarillo, United States, who specializes in creating stunning pieces in dotwork, watercolor, and black & gray styles. Operating out of a private studio in Moorpark, Abe maintains a pristine and hygienic environment, ensuring that cleanliness is a top priority for both the safety and comfort of his clients. With a strong professional ethic, every session at Abe's studio requires a deposit, showcasing his commitment to serious and dedicated artistry.
Price: $
Current location: Camarillo, California, United States
